title: New Orleans Creole Odyssey Small-Group Bike Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness
policies: Dress according to the weather; closed-toed shoes preferable
Wearing flip-flops/slippers while riding a bicycle is hazardous. We prohibit them on our tours. Wearing sandals with heel straps are the perfect alternative.
If you need coffee before the tour, we are located right next door to Twelfth Night Coffee. They serve hot and cold coffee/espresso beverages and croissants/pastries.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore historic New Orleans on this 3-hour small group bike tour through the city to the bayous. Follow your guide as they paint you a picture of a colorful past and vibrant culture of the city. Leisurely ride down the tree lined streets through history as you learn of the settlers who founded this unique port city.
